name: The Age of Electricity
summary: Electricity demand is reaccelerating as compute, cooling, electrification and industrial investment expand load.

name: AI Physical Infrastructure
summary: Power generation, grids, transformers, switchgear, power management and cooling are becoming constraints on compute deployment.

name: High-Speed Compute Connectivity
summary: AI clusters require faster and more power-efficient connectivity across copper, optical and semiconductor interconnects.

name: Vertically Integrated Space
summary: Launch, spacecraft, spectrum and recurring services may consolidate into end-to-end space platforms.

name: Critical Minerals Security
summary: Concentrated refining and magnet production create strategic bottlenecks and policy-supported diversification.

name: Advanced Nuclear Enablers
summary: Regulatory reform and electricity demand are reopening the reactor and nuclear-fuel-cycle opportunity, but commercial timing remains uncertain.

name: Stablecoin Payment Rails
summary: Stablecoins are becoming settlement infrastructure for internet-native payments, built out by payments incumbents rather than crypto-native firms. The question is who captures the economics of the rail, not whether the rail exists.

name: Agentic Commerce
summary: Machine-initiated transactions below the economic floor of card rails. Non-human traffic is claimed to have crossed a majority of the web; whether that converts into per-request settlement or nets off-chain is unresolved and decides the theme.
